title: Cerulean_City
lead_summary:
Cerulean City has four entries: Route 4 from the West, Route 24 from the North, Route 9 from the East, and Route 5 to the South.
This city contains Cerulean City's Gym, with Misty as its leader.
The path south will be blocked by a police officer until the player claims the Cascade Badge.

items.name: TM11 Sunny Day
items.location_details: (Day only)Given by an elderly woman by the bench next to the PokéCenter.

items.name: Fresh Water
items.location_details: Given by the man inside the gym.

items.name: White Flute
items.location_details: Given by the traveler in the South East, after defeating Misty.

items.name: Water Stone
items.location_details: Behind Small Trees in the South East.

items.name: Full Restore
items.location_details: Given by the woman in the hotel after showing her a Pokémon native to Johto.

items.name: Love Ball
items.location_details: Given by the boy in the hotel after delivering hit Love Letter.

items.name: Bicycle
items.location_details: Given by the Bike Shop owner in exchange for a Bike Voucher or ₽100,000.

items.name: TM40 Aerial Ace
items.location_details: Given by the cyclist after beating them in a race.

items.name: Splash Plate
items.location_details: Next to the northwest house, after catching [[Legendary_Pokémon#Arceus

== Points of Interest == === Team Rocket HQ === The building in the northeast of the city, next to the hotel, is being used by Team Rocket as their headquarters. After joining Team Rocket on [[Route 24|Nugget Bridge]], the player can start several [[Quests|missions]] here. === Starter Pokémon Trade === If the player has completed the trade in one of the Pokémon Centers in [[Viridian City]], [[Pewter City]], [[Vermillion City]] or [[Celadon City]], there will be a trainer in the Cerulean Pokémon Center who wants to trade the Kanto starter whose type the player's starter is strong against for a Pokémon with the same type the player started with. For example, if the player started with Charmander, he will offer a Bulbasaur for any Fire-Type Pokémon. === Pledge Move Tutor === A Gentleman in the Pokémon Center will teach [[bulbapedia:Fire Pledge (move)|Fire Pledge]], [[bulbapedia:Grass Pledge (move)|Grass Pledge]] and [[bulbapedia:Water Pledge (move)|Water Pledge]] to the player's Pokémon for {{P$}}500 each.
